name: @sekaran-ind/yaxb-web
description: The YAXB web surface: a Vue single-page app served as Workers static assets, and a Hono Worker for the API (yaxb-core's agent).

scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate:remote && vite build && wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply yaxb --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply anjal-family --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply anjal-business --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply anjal-community --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply anjal-platform --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply yaxb --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply anjal-family --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply anjal-business --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply anjal-community --remote && wrangler d1 migrations apply anjal-platform --remote
